item.title:
After fighting with the 101st Airborne during the Battle of the Bulge, Vincent Speranza returned home and became a teacher, continuing a lifetime of service in the classroom.
Years later, when asked what it was like to be a “celebrity” at American Valor: A Salute to Our Heroes, Speranza simply replied that he wasn’t a celebrity.
Vincent Speranza passed away in 2023 at the age of 98, leaving behind a remarkable legacy of service, humility, and sacrifice.

item.title:
At just 18 years old, Russell Sattazahn was sent into combat with the U.S. Army’s 1st Infantry Division as replacements were desperately needed in Europe during the Battle of the Bulge.
On March 24, 1945, while taking cover from German artillery in the basement of an abandoned house, Sattazahn and his fellow soldiers were struck by a direct hit from a German 88. The blast took his right hand and left him with shrapnel wounds to his face.
Unable to evacuate until the shelling subsided, Sattazahn remained in the destroyed house until the following day, when medics helped him back to a field hospital.
Russell Sattazahn survived, carrying the scars of his service for the rest of his life.
